name: Giant wolf
description: A giant wolf with glowing eyes who thanks Lathril for rescuing one of his children and gives her a gift.

timeline.summary: Lost in the forest, Lathril finds the giant wolf in a glade with the two wolves bowing to him.
timeline.quote: Ahead of her, a giant wolf curled up in the middle of a glade, and the two wolves with whom she had escaped were bowing low to him.

timeline.summary: The giant wolf names her companion Lukya and accepts Lathril's service.
timeline.quote: You have accepted the one that I sent you. Her name is Lukya.

timeline.summary: As a gift, the giant wolf lets any of Lathril's kind safely walk his lands and speak with his beasts.
timeline.quote: any of your kind may safely walk my lands and communicate with my beasts
